subject: POC success criteria & final readout scheduling — Aurora Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramirez <sofia.ramirez@aurorahealth.com>, Kevin Zhao <kevin.zhao@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: POC success criteria & next steps

Hi Sofia / Kevin —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a suggested plan to get the POC moving: 

Summary from call:
- Primary use case: real-time clinical note summarization + downstream coding assistance for the intake team.
- Main constraints: sub-500ms median token latency for triage flow; PHI must never persist to our hosted cache; auditing required for every inference.
- KPIs you care about: precision of extracted fields (~>92%), reduction in triage time (target 25%), and token cost per encounter.

Proposed POC / trial (high-level):
1) Success criteria (what we will measure): see attached poc-success-metrics.xlsx — goal thresholds for accuracy, latency, and throughput.
2) Evaluation plan: 2-week on-real-traffic trial using a 10k-message sample, side-by-side comparison vs current baseline; daily syncs with owners.
3) Timeline: kick-off the week of Apr 4, 2-week trial Apr 5–Apr 18, final readout week of Apr 19.
4) Ownership: Redwood point: Marissa (PM), infra & throughput: Marcus. Aurora point: Sofia (clinical lead), Kevin (IT/procurement).
5) Security/compliance: we recommend Private deployment (VPC) for this trial — see network-checklist.pdf.

Next steps / asks for you:
- Please confirm: success criteria in the attached spreadsheet and availability for a 30-min kick-off the week of Apr 4.
- Who should be on the final readout distribution (execs + procurement)? Sofia, can you loop the right stakeholders (procurement + clinical exec)?

Attachments: poc-success-metrics.xlsx; network-checklist.pdf

Thanks — happy to adjust based on your availability.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the detailed recap — this aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications/notes: 

- Success criteria: the accuracy targets look good but can we add a secondary metric for entity recall on meds? We need to ensure capture for downstream coding.
- Timeline: Apr 5 kick-off works from our side.
- Final readout: our exec team wants a short 20–30 minute top-line review plus 10 minutes for Q&A. Proposed windows: Apr 20 or Apr 21 (morning PT).
- Procurement will need an expected MRR ballpark for post-POC licensing to include in their initial evaluation. Kevin — can you provide timing for procurement review?

I've added Procurement on this thread. Please include a short deck in the final readout focused on cost/throughput tradeoffs and the rollback/fallback plan.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramirez
Director, Clinical Innovation | Aurora Health
sofia.ramirez@aurorahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: POC plan v1 & owners — attachments + kick-off scheduling

Sofia / Kevin —

Thanks — added a row for med-entity recall to the metrics workbook and attached an updated POC plan (poc-plan-aurora-v1.pdf). Key details below: 

POC plan highlights:
- Scope: 2-week live trial against a 10k-message slice of intake data; Redwood will run in Private (VPC) mode with KMS integration.
- Evaluation cadence: daily 15-min standups Mon–Fri; weekly 30-min checkpoint with exec sponsor.
- Success thresholds: accuracy >92% overall, med-entity recall >90%, median inference latency <500ms at 95th percentile under production-like load.
- Cutover/fallback: if latency or accuracy regress below thresholds for 2 consecutive days, we will roll to a lightweight cached model and trigger rollback playbook.
- Ownership: Marissa (POC lead), Marcus (infra lead) — Marcus will provision a dedicated instance and validate network & KMS connectivity. Neha (CS) will manage prompt sets, eval harness, and daily QA queries.

Attachments: poc-plan-aurora-v1.pdf; poa-schedule.ics

Proposed kickoff times (pick one):
- Tue Apr 5, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Apr 6, 14:00–14:30 PT

Marcus / Neha — could you confirm availability for the kick-off and that we'll be able to provision a VPC instance before Apr 5?

Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -07:00

Marissa —

Confirming availability: I can own infra provisioning. Plan: reserve a dedicated 2-GPU instance in us-west-2, pre-load quantized model build, and run a smoke test by Apr 4 EOD. Will need network whitelisting from Aurora and an aligned KMS key (Sofia / Kevin, can your IT team share the KMS ARN and CIDR for the trial?).

On the privacy ask: we can run in VPC mode with no downstream caching. If Aurora needs HSM-backed keys, that is a different procurement path — flagging for Kevin/Procurement.

Neha — I'll hand off the test access and API tokens once the instance is up.

Thanks,
Marcus
